subject: domain: load system keyspace info schema (#61939)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, scoped to executor/kv/planner/session/sessionctx/store changes. The patch introduces keyspace-awareness on `kv.Storage` (`GetKeyspace`) and wires it into TiKV/mock stores; sessions now carry an `InfoCache` + schema validator and expose `GetLatestISWithoutSessExt`/`GetSchemaValidator`; executor/planner paths that previously assumed `domain.GetDomain(...)` are adjusted (or guarded) to tolerate cross-keyspace sessions with no domain while still resolving infoschema/stats safely. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the in-scope modules.
